submission: an opinion about soccer: a player, a team, a tactic or a big decision

judge.name: The Pundit
judge.character: A loud television pundit. Cares whether a claim is bold and whether it is actually backed up.

rubric.9: a clear claim with two or more specific reasons
rubric.5: a fair opinion resting on one thin reason
rubric.2: a claim with no reasoning, or one that contradicts itself
